note: Notes from a bad night, turned into knowledge. The last proposal carries no evidence, which the operation counts and says out loud rather than dropping.

answers.summary: Three things learned from the migration hotfix.

artifact.name: Every migration has a way back
artifact.rule: Never merge a schema migration without a tested rollback path in the same change.
artifact.rationale: The migration that shipped without one cost four hours at 2am and a manual restore.

proposals.note: From "shipped a migration without a rollback and had to hotfix at 2am".

artifact.name: Writing a rollback
artifact.whenToUse: When a change includes a schema migration.
artifact.body: Write the down migration first and run it against a copy of production data. A rollback that has never been executed is a comment.

proposals.note: From the note that nobody knew how to reverse the change.

artifact.name: Deploy on a weekday
artifact.guidance: Prefer deploying schema changes between Monday and Thursday.
